topic: Air stores Demand: Definition, Priority and Reasons/ Occasions.

specific_objectives: 5.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to explain and perform Air stores Demand Air stores Survey utilizing NAMS.

practical: Review NAMS Air Stores Demand Survey Form; Verify Priority Codes; Instructor Supervision: Monitor form completion accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of the NAMS system?
Define 'Air Stores' in the context of naval aviation.
Why is accurate demand forecasting critical for fleet readiness?

development.content:
Definition of Air Stores Demand
Priority Levels for Air Stores
Reasons for Demand Generation
Occasions triggering Demand
Impact on Maintenance Scheduling

Definition of Air Stores Survey
Types of Air Stores Surveys
Reasons for Conducting Surveys
Importance of Survey Data
Survey Frequency and Scope

Procedure for Performing Demand Survey
Data Entry into NAMS System
Verification of Priority Codes
Submission of Survey Report
Common Errors in Survey Process

summary_questions: Explain the difference between Air Stores Demand and Air Stores Survey.
List three occasions that trigger an Air Stores Demand.
How does priority affect the scheduling of air stores replacement?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on how the Air Stores Demand Survey process in LP 05 supports the overall NAMS functions introduced in LP 02.
